error.server_too_old: ChannelBin at {host} is version {reported}. This integration needs ChannelBin {minimum} or newer. Upgrade ChannelBin, then try again.
error.server_version_unknown: ChannelBin at {host} didn't report its version, so it's older than this integration supports. This integration needs ChannelBin {minimum} or newer. Upgrade ChannelBin, then try again.

server_too_old.title: ChannelBin is too old for this integration
server_too_old.description: ChannelBin at {host} is version {reported}, and this integration needs ChannelBin {minimum} or newer. Its sensors stay unavailable until ChannelBin is upgraded. Once it is, this notice clears by itself.

server_version_unknown.title: ChannelBin is too old for this integration
server_version_unknown.description: ChannelBin at {host} didn't report its version, so it's older than this integration supports. This integration needs ChannelBin {minimum} or newer. Its sensors stay unavailable until ChannelBin is upgraded. Once it is, this notice clears by itself.
